orderLead: Free samples and a printed guide for your START moment. Online ordering across START markets is on the way.
orderComingLead: Choose your START program and country, then register for your free box. The form opens with Phase 2 — preview every program below.

kitFitBrandTitle: Where your brand shows on the kit
kitFitBrandLead: By agreement we brand parts of the kit — never the whole box. START stays the kit identity.
kitFitOutsideLabel: Outside — brand on front, flap or corner
kitFitInsideLabel: Inside lid — print on the back of the cover
kitFitExclusivity: * Our commercial approach: we do not offer category exclusivity by default. Per contract and per occasion, we can close a product category for a specific brand.
kitFitPricingTitle: Pricing when you join the kit
kitFitPricingLead: Pricing depends on yearly sample volume, plus size, type, weight and pack volume. The contract sets a price per sample. Guide ads, Online Platform presence, CRM / targeted email follow-up and kit branding are priced separately from sample distribution.
kitFitGuideBrandTitle: Where your brand shows in the guide
kitFitGuideBrandLead: By agreement: an internal full page, the back cover, or a salon — a double-page spread readers open flat.
